<user_query>
You are auditing potential context/performance overhead in this repository for future Cursor agent chats. Do a medium-thorough readonly exploration and return:
1) likely high-cost prompt/context contributors (large always-applied rules, oversized markdown/docs, noisy logs, broad instructions),
2) concrete file paths and why each likely impacts latency/usage,
3) low-risk optimization ideas that preserve behavior.
Focus on AXEL project and .cursor config areas. Keep findings concise and ranked by impact.
</user_query>

Auditing `.cursor` and AXEL for context/performance overhead: scanning rules, skills, large docs, and logs.

[REDACTED]

## Ranked findings (impact on Cursor context / latency)

### Tier A — Highest impact

1. **Duplicate AXEL governance in two always-on channels**  
   - **Paths:** `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\rules\axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc` (~42 lines of dense rules), plus the **same content** pasted in workspace **Always Applied Rules** (visible in chat as `always_applied_workspace_rules`).  
   - **Why:** Same instructions are injected **twice** per turn before any `@` attachments, roughly doubling baseline prompt tokens for AXEL workflows.

2. **Massive NDJSON combat debug logs under repo root**  
   - **Path:** `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\logs\debug\debug-1d1bdd.log` (and siblings `debug-7980eb.log`, `debug-c9d495.log`). One file alone appears **800k+** line-oriented NDJSON rows when opened/read.  
   - **Why:** Any accidental `@logs`, semantic hit, or “read log” tool use can blow context and wall_time; also bloats indexing if not excluded.

3. **Very large third-party / capture JS under `moon_princess_files`**  
   - **Paths:**  
     - `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\exports\moon_princess_files\moonprincess100_mobile.bundle.js` (~**2.57M** characters per read tool)  
     - `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\exports\moon_princess_files\ContainerLauncher_bundle.js` (~**434k** characters)  
   - **Why:** Reference-only in canon, but if the index or a broad search surfaces these, they dominate context. There is **no** `.cursorignore` in the repo to fence them off.

### Tier B — Medium impact

4. **Canonical doc duplication and drift (rule vs file path)**  
   - **Paths:** Governance says read `AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_DOCS.md`, but the file that loads is **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_DOCS.md`** (~204 lines). A root `plans/AI_DOCS.md` path appeared in tooling output but **read failed** (possible phantom/unsynced path).  
   - **Why:** Extra search/read cycles, duplicate maintenance of the same ideas between **`.cursor/rules/axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc`**, **`AI_DOCS.md` §10–13**, and the **QA skill** (see below).

5. **Long scene narrative spec as a first-class agent input**  
   - **Path:** `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\scenes\AXEL_SCENES_NEW.md` (~**999** lines; ends ~line 999).  
   - **Why:** Listed in `SCENE_BUILDER_AGENT_SPEC.md` as a canon source; full-file reads are expensive for scene work.

6. **QA “stack” overlaps (skill + rubric + `AI_DOCS`)**  
   - **Paths:**  
     - `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\skills\axel-simulated-qa\SKILL.md` (~112 lines)  
     - `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\qa\AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md` (≥~194 lines; playtest commands repeated)  
     - `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_DOCS.md` (§11 repeats default commands, bots, persistence)  
   - **Why:** Same command matrices and persistence rules repeated **three ways**; any `qa` turn that loads skill + rubric + `AI_DOCS` pays redundant tokens.

7. **Append-only QA run log with embedded JSON**  
   - **Path:** `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\qa\AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md`  
   - **Why:** Grows every QA run; if agents open the whole file for “history,” cost rises over time (currently moderate in the snippet; trend is upward).

8. **Behavioral “noise” (token cost on answers, not files)**  
   - **Sources:** `axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc` items 7–8, 16–19 and matching `AI_DOCS.md` §9–10 — mandatory **live progress feed** and **premium planning depth** for substantive work.  
   - **Why:** Increases **assistant** output length and turn count, which shows up as higher latency/usage per multi-step task even when codebase context is small.

### Tier C — Lower but non-trivial

9. **Prototype / export JSON and HTML in canon paths**  
   - **Paths:** `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\exports\game_data.json` (~**800+** lines story data), `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\html\game.html` (read shows **716** lines total).  
   - **Why:** Legit canon per `AI_DOCS.md`, but large when pulled whole for narrative tasks.

10. **Other plan markdowns** (combat implementation/design, scene blueprints, item catalog ~282 lines) — fine individually; cumulative **“read everything the rule names”** behavior stacks up.

11. **`.cursor/hooks.json`** — `hooks` empty; negligible overhead.

12. **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.vscode\settings.json`** — only Godot path; negligible for LLM context unless editor syncs it into rules.

---

## Low-risk optimizations (behavior preserved)

| Idea | Rationale |
|------|-----------|
| **Single injection of governance** | Keep **either** workspace always-applied rule **or** the duplicated block in user-level “Always Applied Rules,” not both; point the short one at the long file. |
| **Add `.cursorignore`** (or equivalent in your Cursor version) for `AXEL/axel_project/exports/moon_princess_files/**`, `logs/**`, and `**/*bundle*.js` | Stops index and accidental reads from pulling multi‑MB JS and huge logs. |
| **Shorten `axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc` to an index** | Replace repeated QA command tables with “see `AI_DOCS.md` §11 and `AXEL_QA_REVIEW_RUBRIC.md` §Playtest-mode.” Same behavior if agents still read those on task. |
| **Unify `AI_DOCS` path** | One canonical path in rules/skills (the real `plans/core/AI_DOCS.md`) to cut failed lookups and doc drift. |
| **Split `AXEL_SCENES_NEW.md` by arc** + thin `AXEL_SCENES_NEW.md` as TOC | Scene agent still follows spec; readers load only the chapter they need. |
| **QA log hygiene** | Keep `AXEL_QA_RUN_LOG.md` as a short tail + link or move bulk JSON history to e.g. `qa/archive/*.json` (update `update_qa_analytics.py` to scan both) — **only if** you want to preserve analytics without growing one markdown forever. |
| **Soft cap on progress-feed verbosity** | Keep required fields but one line each — reduces output tokens without dropping the invariant. |

---

**Stuck state:** Not stuck; exploration was read-only and limited to `.cursor`, AXEL plans/exports, `AXEL/html`, and `logs/debug`.

**Executive summary:** The largest avoidable costs are **(1)** duplicated always-on governance (rule file + identical workspace rules), **(2)** huge **`logs/debug/*.log`** and **multi‑MB `moon_princess_files` JS** with no ignore fence, and **(3)** **redundant** QA/scene instructions across the rule, `AI_DOCS.md`, and the QA skill/rubric. Low-risk wins: **dedupe injection**, **`.cursorignore`**, **shorter rule as pointers**, and **splitting** `AXEL_SCENES_NEW.md` / **trimming** the QA run log growth pattern.
